question: Where and in what manner was Kāmākhyā installed within the sacred site?
premises: Kāmākhyā was established as the object of installation.
The installation occurred in the yoni-circle.
The act followed the previous manner.
inference: Kāmākhyā was re-established in the yoni-circle just as before.
plain_english: He established Kāmākhyā in the yoni-circle just as before.
